resources.string: Separate stocks on this phone, each standalone or on its own server
Enter a name of 40 characters at most
A new profile starts empty and standalone. To use it with a server, open it and connect in Settings › Server.
The app restarts to open this profile. Background sync and alerts only run for the profile in use.
Every article, photo and backup of this profile is erased from this phone, with its changes not yet sent to a server. A server keeps this phone in its devices until an Admin removes it.
The profile could not be fully deleted
